Transparency & control

Delete your account & data

You can request deletion of your TruthLens India account without reinstalling the app.

Request deletion by email

  1. Email begoneraj@gmail.com from the Google email address used for TruthLens India.
  2. Use the subject TruthLens India account deletion. State that you want your app account and associated data deleted. Mention if you have lost access to the device or have used multiple devices.
  3. The publisher may reply to verify ownership and clarify which data should be removed. Never send your password, OTP or identity documents.

Compose deletion request

This button opens your email app; it does not submit anything automatically. If it does not open, copy the email address above. You may request deletion of specific data without deleting your account by describing it in your message.

Delete inside the app

Open your profile avatar → Privacy & account controls → Delete my account. Confirm the deletion and reauthenticate with the same Google account. Keep an internet connection until completion. If an error appears, deletion is not confirmed; retry or email support.

What is deleted

The app deletes your Firebase Authentication profile and the current device's notification registration, bookmarks, reading-game progress and preferences. Your Google account is not deleted. No cloud bookmark or game-progress profile is stored. Local copies on other devices must be cleared there; contact support about inaccessible devices or legacy notification records.

What may remain

Public news and third-party content are not your account data. Content shared to other apps remains with its recipients. Provider backups, security logs and records required by law may remain according to the applicable retention rules. If a retention exception applies to your request, the publisher will explain it. See the privacy policy.

We aim to acknowledge requests within 24 hours and resolve them within 15 days after ownership is verified, or explain any delay. Statutory deadlines, where applicable, take precedence.
